correctness.rationale: Backward-branching Riccati equation linearizes; affine composition yields common A and varying B. The adjacent exchange has exact strictly signed factor \(a_{\mathrm{pre}}h_i h_j(b_jd_i-b_id_j)\). Complete sorting minimizes B; full geometric distribution implies all integer stop-loss and thus convex-order bounds, preserved under k independent founders. Exact fractions plus independent forward CTMC corroborate. Fixed mean, survival and variance witness confirmed.

originality.rationale: Foundational Kendall 1948 already provides the general time-inhomogeneous birth/death process, and that distributional law is not claimed new. Comparison of accessible Paradis, Crawford–Suchard and Bhattacharya–Perlman full texts, topical publication searches and published-finding corpus claims found no direct global ratio-sort/strictness/convex-order statement. Absence is not proof of novelty; full Kendall unavailable and an earlier equivalence remains a substantive risk.
residual_risks: The complete 1948 Kendall original could not be read; generalized solution could contain a specialized rearrangement corollary not visible from abstract or modern secondary full texts.
Literature under branching process in a varying environment, Möbius semigroups, or actuarial stochastic-order formulations could yield equivalent ordering without ecology terminology.
Neither peer review nor independent scientific validation has been performed.
No extension to stochastic environmental switches, nonlinear population feedback, immigration or intermediate-time survival is proved.

value.rationale: Decision-theoretic structural result: under fixed inventory of favorable/unfavorable environments, identical aggregate mean can mask severe order-induced differences in extinction risk. One simple ratio sort simultaneously optimizes survival, variance and every convex terminal loss among factorially many schedules. A two-phase exact example changes survival \(2/7\) to \(4/9\) and variance \(5\) to \(5/2\) at identical mean one; strict equality characterization covers arbitrary phase counts.
